title: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of small-molecule HMGB1 inhibitors for the alleviation of radiation-induced skin injury.
authors: Zhuang, Yilong; Cui, Yaowen; Chen, Tingting; Cai, Jinlong; Xu, Jing; Peng, Tao; Wang, Lin; Liu, Shuchen; Zhang, Shouguo
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成小分子HMGB1抑制剂以缓解放射性皮肤损伤，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟预测配体与HMGB1蛋白结合，但核心是药物化学与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Radiation-induced skin injury (RSI) is a common and debilitating complication of radiotherapy, significantly impairing patients' quality of life. High-Mobility Group Box 1 (HMGB1), a key damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) protein, plays a critical role in propagating the inflammatory response following radiation exposure. This study aims to discover small molecule compounds that can antagonize and alleviate radiation-induced skin damage through HMGB1. Two novel classes of compounds were designed and synthesized based on molecular docking analysis of Methotrexate (MTX) and rosiglitazone (RSG) binding to HMGB1. The majority of synthesized compounds exhibited low cytotoxicity (IC(5)(0) > 80 muM). Among them, 30 emerged as the lead candidate, exhibiting significant radioprotective effects in both HaCaT and JB6 cell lines. In vivo, topical application of 30-loaded hydrogel accelerated wound healing, reduced inflammatory cell infiltration, promoted skin regeneration, and significantly regulateddown the levels of inflammatory factors (HMGB1 and IL-6). Mechanistic studies suggest that 30 may exert its protective effects through the HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kappaB signaling pathway, while molecular dynamics simulations predicted stable binding of 30 to HMGB1. In conclusion, 30 represents a novel small-molecule HMGB1 inhibitor with significant therapeutic efficacy against RSI, validating HMGB1 as a viable target for the development of radioprotective agents.
abstract_zh: 放射性皮肤损伤（RSI）是放射治疗中常见且令人衰弱的并发症，显著损害患者的生活质量。高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）作为一种关键的损伤相关分子模式（DAMP）蛋白，在辐射暴露后炎症反应的传播中发挥重要作用。本研究旨在发现能够通过HMGB1拮抗并缓解放射性皮肤损伤的小分子化合物。基于甲氨蝶呤（MTX）和罗格列酮（RSG）与HMGB1结合的分子对接分析，设计并合成了两类新型化合物。大多数合成化合物表现出低细胞毒性（IC(5)(0) > 80 μM）。其中，化合物30脱颖而出，成为先导候选物，在HaCaT和JB6细胞系中均显示出显著的辐射保护作用。在体内实验中，局部应用负载30的水凝胶加速了伤口愈合，减少了炎症细胞浸润，促进了皮肤再生，并显著下调了炎症因子（HMGB1和IL-6）的水平。机制研究表明，30可能通过HMGB1-TLR4-NF-κB信号通路发挥其保护作用，而分子动力学模拟预测了30与HMGB1的稳定结合。总之，30是一种新型小分子HMGB1抑制剂，对RSI具有显著的治疗效果，验证了HMGB1作为开发辐射防护剂的有效靶点。
